args.subject: Free Consultation Request
args.body:
Hello,

I received your email about your event organizing services and would like to book the free consultation you offer. Could you please let me know your available times?

Thank you,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text: I emailed bookings@best-event-organizers.com to ask for the free consultation. That's the booking address in the organizers' email. I asked them to send their available times. I haven't had a reply yet.
